newsitem.title: UK: New Ramco unit to focus on Eastern Europe.
newsitem.headline: New Ramco unit to focus on Eastern Europe.

text.p: British oil and gas company Ramco Energy Plc said on Tuesday it had agreed to invest 4.1 million stg in a new unit that would focus mainly on Eastern Europe.
Ramco said it would have an 82 percent stake in Medusa Oil & Gas Ltd, while the unit's management would hold the remaining interest.

"The Medusa deal complements our activities in the former Soviet Union by giving us interests in established areas with an existing transportation infrastructure and a local demand for our production," Ramco said in a statement.
Medusa, which recently bought two of Tullow Oil Plc's units for 2.1 million stg, plans to spud a well soon near the Austrian/Czech border.
The unit also has four blocks in a prime gas and oil region in Poland, Ramco said. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
